contribution.position: On the reliability axis, the signal is negative: the service is running a 4% error rate against a 1% SLO with two sev2 incidents in the last 30 days (artifact:incident-log). Even with clean tests and passing perf (artifact:test-report, artifact:perf-report), shipping a change into a service already breaching its error budget adds reliability exposure at a moment when stability should take priority.
